paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) across six different datasets for four distinct model configurations. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Dataset," which includes SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, arranged from left to right without a specific alphabetical or ascending/descending sorting order. The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "F1 Score (%)," and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100 with a tick label interval of 10. For each dataset, there is a cluster of four side-by-side bars outlined in black. According to the legend positioned below the chart, the colors within each group represent specific model variations: light green for "MADLLM," purple for "MADLLM w/o feature embedding," blue for "MADLLM w/o prompt pool," and orange for "MADLLM w/o skip embedding." Across all dataset categories, the light green "MADLLM" bars are visually the tallest within their respective groups. The highest value in the entire chart is the light green bar in the PSM group, reaching approximately 97%. Conversely, the shortest bar in the chart is the purple bar in the WADI group, which sits at approximately 63%. Other approximate values across the chart include the light green bar for SMD at 93%, the blue bar for PSM dropping to 77%, the orange bar for SWaT at 85%, the orange bar for SMAP at 67%, the blue bar for MSL at 70%, and the light green bar for WADI at 74%.
